capabilities: track states, notes and dated histories per body region
render clickable figures from profile code blocks
view a tabletop party of characters at a glance
manage an inventory with armor drawn on the figure
define custom figures from SVG files in the vault
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin never connects to the internet and stores nothing outside the vault. Developer docs are kept in AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md and PROGRESS.md.
problem: Obsidian has no visual way to track states of body regions or tabletop characters limb by limb, since such data usually lives as plain lists or tables.

relations.evidence: search, links, Bases, Dataview and sync all keep working

summary: Clickable character-screen tracker that renders body figures from Markdown code blocks, with per-region states, histories, party views and an armor-drawing inventory.
